63489.meaning1: suffusion with ease; fact of pervading with comfort
63489.commentary: (DNa) sukhaṃ pharamānaṃ uppajjatī'ti tīsu jhānesu paññā sukhapharaṇatā nāma.

examples.text: pañc'aṅgiko sammāsamādhi, pītipharaṇatā, sukhapharaṇatā, cetopharaṇatā, ālokapharaṇatā, paccavekkhaṇanimittaṃ. ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā.

63490.meaning1: with pleasant fruit; with nice results
63490.commentary: (JAa) sukhapphalan'ti, samma abhipāraka, paṇḍitā attano dukkhena phuṭṭhā samānā na sukhavipākadāyakakammaṃ pariccajanti, sammohitā vā'pi hutvā mohena mūḷhā sukhena mattā pāpakammaṃ nāma na samācaranti.

examples.text: dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti, n'ādinnaṃ hoti taṃ tathā, corā haranti rājāno, aggi ḍahati nassati.
so āyudāyī vaṇṇadāyī, sukhabaladado naro, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.

63492.meaning1: abundantly comfortable; with lots of good
63492.commentary: (MNa) sukhabahulā vedanā'ti manussaloke khattiyakul'ādīsu sukhabahulā vedanā vedayitabbā hoti, tā vedayamānaṃ nipannaṃ vā nisinnaṃ vā passāmī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena tassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā sukhabahulā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.
atthassa pattiṃ hadayassa santiṃ, jetvāna senaṃ piyasātarūpaṃ, eko'haṃ jhāyaṃ sukham'anubodhiṃ, tasmā janena na karomi sakkhiṃ, sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci me'ti.

63497.meaning1: indulges in pleasure; engages in gratification

examples.text: sukhavinicchayaṃ jaññā, sukhavinicchayaṃ ñatvā ajjhattaṃ sukham'anuyuñjeyya.

63498.grammar: aor of sukhaṃ seti, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.

63499.grammar: aor, reflx 3rd sg of sukhamasayi, comp vb, intrans
63499.meaning1: one slept well; one rested comfortably

examples.text: kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.
